name: Saturn USDat
oneLiner: USDat is Saturn's non-yield-bearing M0-backed dollar token, mintable and redeemable through KYC-gated Swap Facility flows.
collateral: 100% backed by M (M0 Protocol's tokenized short-term U.S. Treasury bills) at launch — capital is held directly in the USDat smart contract and verifiable on-chain; protocol roadmap allows reserves to shift toward digital credit instruments (e.g. Strategy STRC preferred equity) over time
pegMechanism: Permissioned 1:1 mint by depositing USDC via the M0 Swap Facility (Uniswap V3 1bps tier) which routes through wM; redemption returns USDC by unwrapping USDat back to wM and burning the USDat. Only KYC-onboarded addresses can mint, redeem, or hold USDat; geofenced away from US, EEA, and OFAC-sanctioned jurisdictions

proofOfReserves.provider: Saturn Protocol (on-chain reserve, with Accountable + Chainlink NAV oracle integration in progress)

genius.notes: Saturn documents USDaT reserve and redemption mechanics, but no public GENIUS issuer approval or registration was located. USDat is explicitly geofenced away from US and EEA users per protocol design; Saturn is BVI-domiciled with no known US regulatory registration.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS approval, state-qualified approval, official application, foreign-exception registration, or issuer-announced intent was located for USDaT. Saturn is BVI-domiciled and geofences US persons; no GENIUS pathway disclosure found in issuer materials.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Within the current runtime-selected material snapshot, USDat is an issuer-native M0 extension on Ethereum and a Chainlink CCIP burn/mint representation on Monad. Pinned Monad reads identify the sole MINTER_ROLE holder as a CCIP BurnMintTokenPool whose configured Ethereum remote token is the canonical USDat deployment; deployments not selected by this snapshot are outside this binding pass.

This is a locally issued M0 extension wrapped and unwrapped through the Ethereum SwapFacility, not a cross-chain bridge representation.

mintAuthority.summary: USDat is an M0-backed extension on Ethereum; extension wrapping routes through M0 extension infrastructure while base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing USDat depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.

routeChecks.attestorQuorum: M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint.
routeChecks.caps: Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy; cap governance remains with M0 TTG and Registrar governance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295161: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders).

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply.
routeChecks.caps: SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: SwapFacility is reviewed as the same ProxyAdmin -> TimelockController governance pattern as verified MUSD.
